text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before the race, Lucky Lilac had her eyes 
closed, taking deep breath after deep 
breath. However, the aura coming from her 
felt less like calm, and more like—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...You really can't hide it after all, can 
you?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
No matter how deeply I breathed in, it 
wouldn't settle down at all.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
My legs are still rattling away even now. 
...I guess they're just dying to run 
already.
choice_data_list: I can't wait to see you run either.
I can't wait to see you run too

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. In that case, please wait for me.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you—just how splendidly I can 
bloom.
